appDescription: DAON (다온, '다녀간 곳에 온기를 남기다') lets a family or friends group leave a few warm words at a place or a driving moment. The words are played back later in the other members' cars when they pass that place or meet that moment.

function.name: RECORD_DAON
function.description: Start recording a short spoken message from the driver for one of the driver's groups, such as family or friends; the app then asks for the words and records them itself, so the request does not need to contain the words.

group.description: The exact name of one of the driver's groups, only when the driver said it right before the request. Leave it out otherwise; the current group is used.
